QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` (`//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`). `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` are also commented out (lines 2185, 2196).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the shipped config header leaves THREADING_C and the PTHREAD/ALT macros commented out, so the default build defines none of them.
